# Carregando os pacotes

```{r setup}
library(Biostrings)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
```

# Diretórios

```{r}
BASE_DIR <- getwd()
PHYLOGENY_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "RESULTS", "PHYLOGENY")
FIGURES_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "RESULTS", "FIGURES")
MATRIX_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "RESULTS", "MATRIX")
```

# Importando os arquivos

```{r}
# Metadados
metadata = read_xlsx("metadata.xlsx")

# Arquivo de alinhamento:
alignment_file <- file.path(PHYLOGENY_DIR, paste0("viral_sequences_aligned.aliview.fasta"))

# Lendo as sequências:
sequences <- readDNAStringSet(alignment_file)

# Convertendo para caracteres:
seq_matrix <- as.matrix(sequences)
```

# Calculando a identidade nucleotidica

```{r}
# Função para calcular identidade:
calculate_identity <- function(seq1, seq2) {

  valid <- seq1 != "-" &
           seq2 != "-" &
           seq1 != "N" &
           seq2 != "N"

  if (sum(valid) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  identity <- sum(seq1[valid] == seq2[valid]) /
              sum(valid) * 100

  return(identity)
}

# Criando a matriz:
n <- length(sequences)
identity_matrix <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = n,
  ncol = n,
  dimnames = list(
    names(sequences),
    names(sequences)))

for (i in seq_len(n)) {

  for (j in seq_len(n)) {

    identity_matrix[i, j] <- calculate_identity(
      seq_matrix[i, ],
      seq_matrix[j, ]
    )
  }
}

# Arredondando:
identity_matrix <- round(identity_matrix, 2)

# Alterando os nomes das linhas
rownames(identity_matrix) = metadata$Sequence

# Alterando os nomes das colunas
colnames(identity_matrix) = metadata$Sequence
```

# Heatmap

```{r}
# Organizar metadata de acordo com a matriz:
metadata_heatmap <- metadata[match(rownames(identity_matrix), 
                                   metadata$Sequence),]

# Conferir correspondência:
stopifnot(all(rownames(identity_matrix) == metadata_heatmap$Sequence))

# Definir nomes das linhas:
rownames(metadata_heatmap) <- metadata_heatmap$Sequence

# Definir cores das anotações:
annotation_colors <- list(
  Genotype = c("G1" = "#1F78B4", "G3" = "#33A02C", "G4" = "#FF7F00", "G40" = "#6A3D9A", 
               "G9" = "#E31A1C", "G10" = "#FB9A99"),
  Host = c("Homo sapiens" = "#4D4D4D", "Vaccine strain" = "#E31A1C", "Jungle crow" = "#33A02C"))

# Definir cores das escalas:
col = colorRamp2(
  c(min(identity_matrix, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(range(identity_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max(identity_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)),
  c("#BC5943", "#FFFFFF", "#3F7B90"))

# Anotação das colunas:
column_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Genotype = metadata_heatmap$Genotype,
  Host = metadata_heatmap$Host,
  col = annotation_colors,
  show_legend = TRUE)

# Criar heatmap:
p_heatmap <- Heatmap(
  identity_matrix,
  name = "Nucleotide identity",
  col = col,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_names_rot = 45,
  top_annotation = column_annotation,
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    grid.text(
      sprintf("%.3f", identity_matrix[i, j]),
      x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
    )
  },
  border = FALSE)

# Visualizar:
p_heatmap
```

# Salvando os arquivos

```{r}
# Heatmap:
ggsave(filename = file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "heatmap_nucleotide_identity.pdf"), 
       plot = p_heatmap, width = 12, height = 12)

# Matriz de identidade nucleotídica:
write.xlsx(identity_matrix, 
           file.path(MATRIX_DIR,"nucleotide_identity_matrix.xlsx"), 
           rowNames = TRUE)
```
